cr_data.provenance: (Alfred Stieglitz, New York, NY); Paul Rosenfeld, New York, NY, 1920s; Estate of Paul Rosenfeld, 1946; Edna Bryner (Mrs. Arthur) Schwab, New York, NY, bequest, 1946; (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); (Midtown Galleries, San Francisco, California); Charlotte (Mrs. Adolph) Mack, San Francisco, California, 1946 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Paul Rosenfeld's apartment, 2/11/46. No signature. . . . Rosenfeld thinks this is Lake George. Shows lake with hills beyond. Rosenfeld thinks about 1921. Bought from O'Keeffe. Owned Paul Rosenfeld. Miss O'Keeffe thinks this was painted in 1922."Downtown Gallery Archive dates 1922 and 1928? Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1922. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
